title: Wag Gets Wet
lines: Deb, Ned and Wag run in the fog.
Wag digs in the mud. Wag is wet!
"Look at Wag," said Deb. "He is wet."
Ned gets a big rag and rubs his legs.
Deb rubs him and Wag wags and wags.
"We can set him in his den," said Ned.
Wag naps in the den. He is not wet.

questions.listenFor: He dug in the mud. Line two says it. If your child is stuck, put a finger on that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: What did Ned use to rub Wag?
questions.listenFor: A big rag. Line four says it. One word is plenty here.

questions.ask: Walk me through how Wag got dry, step by step.
questions.listenFor: Ned rubbed his legs with a rag, Deb rubbed him too, then he napped in his den. Lines four to seven.
